title: Oklahoma Cop Shoots Suspect Who Threw Board and Bricks at Him
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Oklahoma City, Oklahoma — On September 24th, 2025, just after 3:00 a.m., Oklahoma City Police received multiple 911 calls to the 3000 block of Southwest 64th Terrace regarding a disturbance involving a man standing outside, shouting and making threats towards children. The first officer arrived on scene and found 45-year-old Jason Redshirt yelling outside of a residence. The officer immediately began trying to de-escalate the situation and calm Redshirt down. Redshirt responded by cursing at and threatening the officer while shouting racial slurs. He then approached the officer in an aggressive manner and was pepper-sprayed. Redshirt retreated to a trailer parked in a nearby driveway. Close to the trailer, were numerous bricks as well. 

Redshirt picked up a board from the trailer and presented it as a weapon towards the officer. The officer again pepper-sprayed Redshirt in an effort to get him to drop the board, along with giving him multiple commands to stop. Redshirt hurled the large board at the officer, striking him. Redshirt then continued to assault the officer by throwing multiple bricks at him. Upon being assaulted with the bricks and board, the officer discharged his firearm at Redshirt, striking and wounding him. Redshirt was transported to an area hospital for treatment. He was arrested on two counts of assault and battery with a dangerous weapon. The officer sustained a non-life-threatening injury from being struck by the items that were hurled at him. The involved officer has been placed on routine administrative leave pending the outcome of the investigation.
